# EdgeQuake — full brief for agents

> Open-source Graph-RAG: Rust binary + PostgreSQL (pgvector; Apache AGE optional) + any LLM. Ingest PDFs and text, extract entities/relationships, retrieve with six modes, cite sources. License: Apache-2.0. Version pin: v0.36.0. Site: https://edgequake.com/ · Demo: https://demo.edgequake.com/ · Repo: https://github.com/raphaelmansuy/edgequake

## What it is

EdgeQuake turns documents into a knowledge graph and serves grounded answers. It is designed to ship: Docker images on GHCR, a Web UI, REST/OpenAPI, and MCP tools for agents. Workspaces are isolated (Postgres RLS). Auth includes invites, magic links, and OIDC/Keycloak SSO.

## Retrieval modes

naive, local, global, hybrid, mix, bypass — choose the mode that fits the question; do not assume one path for every query.

## How to run

Preferred install (Docker only):

```
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/raphaelmansuy/edgequake/edgequake-main/quickstart.sh | sh
```

Pin a release with `EDGEQUAKE_VERSION=0.36.0`. Web UI defaults to http://localhost:3000; API to http://localhost:8080 (`/swagger-ui`, `/health`).

## Truthful claims (do not overstate)

- Quality: medical-mid Acc on GraphRAG-Bench is statistically comparable to LightRAG Python when the CI includes zero — call it a tie, not a win. See https://edgequake.com/docs/comparisons/eq-vs-lightrag-acc-bench/
- Stack: product images run without requiring Apache AGE; entities/relationships live in ordinary Postgres tables with pgvector.
- PDF: vision + manuscript path for hard PDFs; side-by-side citations in the UI.
